parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
You calculate the value of the core, C, by multiplying the core integer by itself.
In the example C = 15 # 15 = 225.
Calculate C for the sequence in part (a).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
You calculate the value of the shell, S, by multiplying the two shell integers together.
In the example S = 6 # 24 = 144.
Calculate S for the sequence in part (a).

In the Fibonacci sequence you find the next term by adding the previous two terms.
For example 5th term + 6th term = 7th term so 5 + 8 = 13.
